projects.name: ML-building-models
projects.description: A schema-driven ML pipeline that builds surrogate models from EnergyPlus simulation data to estimate building energy consumption from easily available building properties. It spans building types, HVAC systems and climate zones.
highlights: Scan, catalog and train CLI turns raw EnergyPlus CSVs into fitted models per use case.
Savings are computed as baseline minus proposed model predictions for the same buildings.
The résumé reports 1.1–3.3% average CVRMSE for the related DOE 179D surrogates across 16 climate zones.

projects.name: building-rom-automation
projects.description: Automates reduced-order building envelope models with an RC structure, trained and tested on EnergyPlus simulation data. A config-driven pipeline edits IDFs, runs simulations, processes outputs and runs EKF-based 4R2C identification.
highlights: Full pipeline from raw ResStock IDFs to processed EKF training data, with config consistency checks.
Two-pass augmented-state EKF freezes parameters for held-out validation and test evaluation.
Candidates in the parameter grid are scored by RMSE on the validation segment.

projects.name: AUMC-community-modeling
projects.description: Develops 3R2C thermal models for a community of 148 commercial buildings.
highlights: Covers a community of 148 commercial buildings.

projects.name: modelcanary
projects.description: Progressive delivery for ML models: a FastAPI gateway serves ONNX models in shadow and then canary stages. Sequential tests decide automatic promotion or rollback, and every decision goes to a tamper-evident audit trail.
highlights: Error rate, latency and a business metric are monitored with Wald SPRT and always-valid confidence sequences.
SHA-256 hash-chained audit log detects edits, deletions and reordering.
Evaluated against a ground-truth simulator over thousands of held-out seeds.

projects.name: labelbudget
projects.description: An active-learning benchmark that reports labels needed to reach a target accuracy, with variance across many seeds, next to a prominent random-sampling baseline. A comparison guard refuses claims the evidence does not support.
highlights: Target accuracy is 97% of the full-pool score; the random baseline is always run.
Paired bootstrap CI and exact sign test, with no comparative claim below 10 seeds.
Pure Python standard library with 25 tests.

projects.name: sliceguard
projects.description: A fairness slice auditor that uses Wilson intervals, Benjamini-Hochberg correction and minimum detectable effect, so tiny slices stop producing false alarms.
highlights: Slices are ranked by the lower bound of the gap interval, not the raw point estimate.
Slices too small to rule out a material gap are marked INDETERMINATE rather than fair.
Demo audits 6,000 synthetic evaluations with two planted 9-point disparities.

projects.name: greenpulse-energy-monitoring
projects.description: An AI-powered energy monitoring and optimization platform for commercial buildings. It combines real-time consumption dashboards, ML anomaly detection, LSTM demand forecasting and carbon tracking.
highlights: LSTM models forecast energy usage up to 7 days ahead, with hourly load forecasts and confidence intervals.
Anomaly detection flags equipment malfunctions, after-hours consumption and demand spikes.
Cost analysis covers time-of-use rate and demand-charge optimization.

projects.name: propertyiq-real-estate
projects.description: An ML-powered real estate investment platform that predicts property values 12 months ahead and scores investment opportunities, with market heatmaps, neighborhood analytics and a cash flow calculator.
highlights: 12-month price prediction with MAPE under 8%.
Every property gets a 0-100 investment score based on ROI potential.
Models include XGBoost, LightGBM, Prophet and a neural network for image analysis.

projects.name: weather-data-pipeline-great-expectations
projects.description: A weather data pipeline that collects hourly observations from 50+ global cities via the Open-Meteo API, validates every batch with Great Expectations, and transforms data through dbt into analytics-ready BigQuery tables.
highlights: Quality gates check schema, null rates under 5%, value ranges, row counts and freshness under 3 hours.
Failed checks halt the pipeline and send Slack alerts.
21 unit tests pass across 5 test suites.
